locations.name: Berea Falls Scenic Overlook
locations.addressOrOperatorDescription: Operator visitor approach near Barrett Road and Valley Parkway, Berea
locations.arrivalInstructions: Use the operator destination pin and ordinary visitor lot. A route corridor from the start is Bagley Road toward Barrett Road, then the designated falls visitor approach; this is not turn-by-turn guidance. Follow legal road signs and posted conditions. Stop safely before opening evidence.
locations.walkingPlan: Optional designated overlook approach: approximately 0.11–0.15 mile return including an ordinary lot allowance, a planning estimate rather than a field measurement. If your available approach is longer, icy or obstructed, skip it and use the complete reference.
restrictions: Stay on the maintained designated public approach; no railway land, stream banks, scrambling or water entry.
Use ordinary legal visitor parking; no shoulder stop, reserved space or guaranteed bay. Posted closures control.
General reservation hours are published as 06:00–23:00; that does not promise safe light, clear paths or 2027 access.
In winter, finish optional outdoor observation by about 16:30, earlier in poor light. There is no need to hurry or find a physical detail.

locations.name: North Quarry Picnic Area
locations.addressOrOperatorDescription: Northern end of Wallace Lake; off Valley Parkway north of North Quarry Lane, Berea
locations.arrivalInstructions: Use the operator’s northern picnic-area destination pin, not the main beach pin. From the falls approach, the researched road corridor follows Barrett Road to Valley Parkway and the North Quarry visitor entrance. Follow current road signs and normal visitor access. Continue as ordinary shared recreation, giving way to others.
locations.walkingPlan: No shore, bridge, beach or particular table is required. Optional exploration is an out-and-back of at most about 100 yards outward from the car including lot travel; turn back earlier if needed. This chosen bound is not a measured distance to any feature.
restrictions: Use lawful shared recreation space, not a restricted or reserved facility; no table, shelter, lighting or clear winter path is guaranteed.
The operator describes most picnic areas as free shared use; honor any site-specific posted restriction. No paid or exclusive facility is required.
Do not enter water, ice, closed paths, reserved spaces or work areas. Do not stage a long game session in a municipal parking lot.
Finish winter exploration by about 16:30 or earlier if conditions require. Later chapters are documentary work from a lawful safe stationary position.
If no comfortable lawful space is available, keep the case and resume elsewhere using references. No GPS or visit proof is required.
